items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I guess everybody tried to emulate King Cole at the time, and we were no exception.

ctx.x: That was '44 or '45, somewhere in there. I signed up with the William Morris Agency, and they booked my little trio. We worked upstate New York through Ohio, and all kind of crazy little gigs. We'd play our little music and sing songs, you know. I guess everybody tried to emulate King Cole at the time, and we were no exception.
